kind: Storage maintenance, not a biological experiment
method: Largest-first inactive directory migration; rsync copy/checksum verification, Linux atomic directory<->symlink exchange, delete only verified old /home duplicate
selection: Directories only; skip links, symlink-containing trees, special files, own-user process-referenced runs, recently modified(<30min) runs and hidden folders
retention: All trajectories, weights, selected/final models, checkpoints, optimizer/RNG, raw stdout and recursive reference dependencies retained. Old absolute paths resolve through per-run symlinks. Top-level logs stay in /home.
guards: No own-user active references before swap
Checksum dry-run must show no differences
Old open descriptors/cwd prevent deleting duplicate
Destination free space must exceed apparent copy size+10GiB
Any failure leaves data copies for review
journals: /tmp/r-elegans-archive-<UTC>-<PID>.jsonl plus archive copy; stdout log in/tmp
limitations: Actual /data permissions/quota not yet verified; permission/copy failure deletes no original data
Linux atomic swap not executed on local Mac; tested with temporary-file exchange emulation
Background new-job races are handled conservatively but can leave duplicate copies needing review
No claimed amount reclaimed until server journal/df provided
additional_fix: Future E077 workers/coordinator reserve50GiB free before new work/large trace writes; already-running processes retain old code
